query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as lancamentos,
  SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as dpote,
  COUNT(*) as dias
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE empresaSlug IN ('barbiero-mascote', 'barbiero-morumbi') 
  AND data LIKE '2026-07%' 
  AND CAST(SUBSTRING(data, 9, 2) AS UNSIGNED) <= 15
GROUP BY empresaSlug;
